method.data: Train two independent directions. Each sees the synthetic substitutions and same-word resampling from just one generator plus shared genuine controls. Match dry and noisy training within each prompt. The operating-point readers and held readers are separate from fitting.
method.held: Each direction scores the generator that contributed no training positives. Keep speakers and meeting captures outside fit/calibration. Report distinct locations, matched-control collisions, false alarms (including the isolated backgrounds), and misses. Compare original PCM to the current timed review, and earlier saved whole-model methods only on their own cohorts.
method.inputs: Use centered 25 ms frames every 10 ms and fixed 64 triangular Mel power bands. Standardize each band using only the respective fit pool. Teach exact per-frame content labels and splice edges within 30 ms. Optimize binary losses, paired synthetic-versus-genuine rankings, and consistency of the local margins between the dry and loud competing-speech views.
method.points: Use only genuine files from the calibration readers, excluding the other generator's resampling. Seal one strict cutoff at the maximum genuine score and one wider cutoff at the 95th percentile of genuine foreground scores, bounded below by the highest background-only score. Both use a strict comparison. Cutoffs are shared across dry and noisy views and are not probabilities.
method.readout: Propose .50, .75 and 1.00 s intervals every 100 ms. Use mean content response plus 0.15 times the mean of the strongest learned edge responses within 40 ms of the two endpoints. Require at least half detected speech and return the strongest span, with earlier/shorter ties.

method.background: Select source-clock AMI excerpts for fitting and calibration from two different sessions. Prefer disjoint excerpts within AMI sessions. Use the three frozen ICSI rooms for held trials, balance excerpt reuse and align the held foreground crop to annotated overlap. Require annotated overlapping background speech over at least half the edit.
method.sources: Select eight distinct aligned utterances per declared reader, with four short and four longer edits. Exclude foreground utterances used in the nested AMI/ICSI training follow-up and exact historical v9 keys. Partition readers by hash before measuring any classifier. Retain the same word sequence in both TTS renditions.
method.variants: Use matched untouched, same-reader genuine word substitution, ordinary same-word resampling for each generator, generated same-word substitution for each generator, and isolated-background controls. Apply the same 20 ms fades and local RMS matching for all edits. Whole-host mixture ratio is -5 dB. Dry and wet inputs use the same PCM target with exact shared integer background addition.
